items.quote: he himself was eager to leave, because the Lord had afflicted him.
items.contrast: The reader must distinguish why Uzziah himself wanted to leave from the priests’ separate action of hurrying him out.
items.reason: The passage directly identifies the Lord’s afflicting Uzziah with leprosy as the cause of his eagerness to leave. The priests’ response is related but is not presented as the reason for his own eagerness.
